newsitem.title: Spain: ETA kidnap victim shot but alive, in coma in Spain.
newsitem.headline: ETA kidnap victim shot but alive, in coma in Spain.

text.p: A Spanish politician kidnapped by Basque ETA guerrillas has been found shot in the head but is alive and in a coma, hospital sources said on Saturday. Earlier official sources said he had been killed.
Basque guerrillas ETA kidnapped Miguel Angel Blanco on Thursday and threatened to kill him at 4 p.m. (1400 GMT) on Saturday if the government did not change its prison policy.

Blanco had been found, with his hands tied, by a hunter who heard a shot in a wooded area near the northern Basque coastal city of San Sebastian. He was rushed to hospital where officials said he was dead.
The attempted killing took place despite a rally of half a million Spaniards led by Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar in the northern Basque capital Bilbao to protest against the kidnapping.
ETA has killed some 800 people since starting a drive for Basque independence in 1968.
The rebels have set deadlines to execute kidnap victims twice before, in 1981 and 1983, and in both cases the hostages were killed.
